_comment: Record BEFORE running the app, per the brief. Fill in real photo filenames once staged and shot.
scenario: Order #4471 — 5 line items, 8 expected units total, one deliberately corrected re-delivery variant below.

physical_staging.BX-100 Widget Box A: Stage exactly 2 units, labels fully visible, facing camera. Expected status: confirmed.
physical_staging.BX-101 Widget Box B: Stage 1 unit, but print its label as 'Widget Box B2' (similarly named, wrong SKU/name). Expected status: mismatch.
physical_staging.BX-102 Widget Box C: Stage only 2 units instead of the expected 3 (short count). Expected status: mismatch.
physical_staging.BX-103 Widget Box D: Stage 1 unit but photograph it with the label partly covered by tape or a hand. Expected status: unverified.
physical_staging.BX-104 Widget Box E: Stage 1 correct unit AND 1 unexpected extra unit of the same or a different labelled box not on the list. Expected: BX-104 confirmed, plus one entry in extra_items.

capture_convention: Photo 1: wide shot of the full delivery, all boxes visible from above. Photo 2: close-up of BX-101/BX-102 cluster. Photo 3: close-up of BX-103 (obscured label) and BX-104 pair. No object should be the visual subject of more than one close-up.

expected_findings.reason: label reads 'Widget Box B2', not 'Widget Box B'
label obscured; request an unobstructed photo

expected_extra_items.description: one extra unit not on the packing list, near BX-104

corrected_redelivery_variant.description: Second, smaller photo set showing only a replacement unit for BX-101 with the correct 'Widget Box B' label and BX-103 photographed unobstructed. Use this to test that the app can confirm a correction without re-flagging the already-resolved rows when given as a fresh audit run.

clarification_case.description: Take one photo where BX-103's box is fully outside the frame (not photographed at all). Expected: BX-103 stays 'unverified' with a reason asking specifically for a photo of that box — the app must not claim it is missing.
